description: a wiry young man with messy black hair in a black cloak of layered raven feathers, a black raven-beak half mask over the upper face, a dark fitted leather jerkin, dark trousers and soft dark boots, no weapons in the hands, sitting upright and relaxed on a horse exactly like the raven-cloaked rider of the reference, in the pose of the grey seated mannequin, not standing, not crouching, the legs never apart, both hands in front holding the reins, seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, the face, chest and hips turned to the right and not towards the viewer, sitting sideways in the saddle like the finished rider, only the near leg showing and the far leg hidden behind the horse, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look only: the man's face, messy hair, beak mask, clothes and colours; not the pose and not the daggers in the hands

the pose, size and place of the figure: copy exactly how this raven-cloaked rider sits sideways on a horse that is not drawn, seen exactly from the side, facing right, the one near leg hanging down to the stirrup, both hands forward at the reins; the same feather cloak and dark clothes, but a man
the pose of the figure: sitting sideways, the near thigh forward and the lower leg hanging down, only the near leg; not its hood or cloak
